mn47:1.1: This Sutta is much altered in the original MS, but the renderings there have been compared with a later typed sheet of the Sutta in translation. The latter version is sometimes preferable to the former.
mn47:5.3: ‘Mixed’ means partly good (bright) and partly evil (dark). See paras. 15-16 below.
mn47:8.3: para. 8. ñattajjhāpanna—has acquired renown: ñatta not in P.T.S. Dict.
mn47:14.2: para. 16. The treatment of the intricate use of the word ‘dhamma’ here is guided by the Tīkā (Sub-commentary).
mn47:16.1: para. 17. For ‘saddhā nivitthā’ cf. Sutta 95, para. 20 saddhaṁ niveseti.
